name: std::bitset<N>::to_ullong
intro:
Converts the contents of the bitset to an unsigned long long integer.

The first bit of the bitset corresponds to the least significant digit of the number and the last bit corresponds to the most significant digit.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: std::overflow_error if the value can not be represented in unsigned long long.

summary: Converts the contents of the bitset to an unsigned long long integer.
